limits: Native4.20 client tooltip and Riot4.20.1 tooltip both require half cooldown refund on Q kill; earlier mana-only implementation incorrect.

Implement half of cast-time CDR-adjusted duration, subtract from committed deadline at impact and clamp current tick. Scope refund to matching committed cooldown so delayed old missiles do not alter a newer cast. Exact original refund arithmetic/late-missile behavior remains reconstructed.

Pyromania native descriptions establish four casts and next offensive spell stuns; native duration remains dynamic @f1@. MarkerPersistsThroughDeath=true and NonDispellable=true are recovered metadata, not proof that stack counts or ready buff survive death. Do not infer modern initial4stacks or reset-ondeath behavior.
No passive stack/stun implementation or primary historical stun duration qualified in this audit.
